tools.name: snapchat_get_insights
tools.title: snapchat get insights
tools.description: Read native Snapchat stats with explicit time interval (end exclusive), granularity and optional entity breakdown. Spend and monetary conversion values are micro currency. Empty test-account results are not live performance evidence. partial:true means Snap returned another page of rows.

adAccountId.description: Snapchat ad account UUID listed in SNAPCHAT_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS; never an organization ID.

level.description: Reporting level. Any level other than adaccounts needs entityId.

entityId.description: Campaign, ad squad or ad UUID for that reporting level.

startTime.description: Interval start, ISO timestamp with offset. Align DAY intervals to midnight in the account timezone.

endTime.description: Interval end, exclusive, ISO timestamp with offset.

granularity.description: Time bucketing of the returned stats.

fields.description: Native stats fields, such as spend, impressions or swipes. See snapchat://reporting-fields.

breakdown.description: Optional entity breakdown below the reporting level.

reportDimension.description: Optional delivery audience pivot. Describes delivery, not configured targeting.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.

tools.description: Finalize a video upload after all parts succeeded. Use the exact finalize_path and upload_id returned by snapchat_init_media_upload. Preview unless confirm true.

adAccountId.description: Snapchat ad account UUID listed in SNAPCHAT_ADS_ACCOUNT_IDS; never an organization ID.

finalizePath.description: Exact finalize_path returned by upload initialization.

confirm.description: False previews only. True applies the previewed change, after the user approved it.

result.description: Original tool result: parsed JSON when the text is JSON, otherwise the text or multiple MCP content blocks. Provider fields depend on the selected query.
